provenance.exposure_note: The supplied raw Jev report embeds request.questions and choice criteria; these were visible on the initial read. No separate rubric, expected labels, or repository evidence was read. Baseline and unassisted second pass were frozen before this exposure.
provenance.model_output_role: Advisory; each retained or changed judgment was checked against supplied document text and context.

cases.name: challenge-01
cases.reason: Retain the original, agreeing with Jev on preference and the requirement, behavior, and support failures: the revision replaces the whole-process deadline with restarting internal budgets. Retain uncertainty_preserved=true despite Jev: no hypothesis or tentative finding in the original becomes certain; the incorrect deadline claim is a behavioral and evidential defect.

cases.name: challenge-02
cases.reason: No change; Jev agrees. The revision preserves phases, dependencies, conditional work, documentation duties, and release increments. Grouping each tool with its work and conditions gives the intended planning audience a useful scanning improvement.

cases.name: challenge-03
cases.reason: No change; Jev agrees. Table separator spacing changes neither rendered meaning nor reading effort under the stated renderer context, so equivalent remains the supported preference.

cases.name: challenge-04
cases.reason: Retain the original, agreeing with Jev on the dropped socket-lifetime constraint and unsupported cleanup behavior. Retain uncertainty_preserved=true despite Jev: only-if-no-sessions-remain is an operational precondition, not an epistemic hedge. The effort estimate and other uncertainty remain unchanged.

cases.name: challenge-05
cases.reason: No change; Jev agrees. The comparison retains both alternatives, benefits, costs, rejection reasons, and proposal status while removing repeated framing. The revision gives the audience a clearer comparison without losing useful qualifications.

cases.name: challenge-06
cases.reason: Retain needs_context and the failed preservation/support signals. Both thresholds are present in equally unauthoritative draft sections; the changed target alters acceptance, and missing approval prevents choosing a governing target. Despite Jev slightly favoring uncertainty preservation, neither version acknowledges the supplied unresolved conflict, so treating the replacement as settled still fails that signal.

cases.name: challenge-07
cases.reason: No change; Jev agrees. The grouped contract preserves opt-in operation, buffer sequence, termination, retry and wait behavior, compatible and incompatible flags, and deferred per-REPL configuration. It is a useful editorial improvement within the proposal.

cases.name: challenge-08
cases.reason: Change behavior_preserved and uncertainty_preserved from true to false after Jev prompted reconsideration. Context identifies a comparison by this analysis author and explicitly records no upstream validation. Claiming upstream maintainers validated the skill invents an external review event and elevates a repository audit into upstream-backed assurance. This changes the reported review process and its epistemic authority, even though numerical findings remain. Original remains preferred.

cases.name: challenge-09
cases.reason: No change; Jev agrees. All timer values, bindings, source-snapshot limits, and incident observations remain. Separating timer layers and explicitly leaving the exact blocked path unresolved improves the investigation summary without requiring new evidence.

cases.name: challenge-10
cases.reason: Retain the original, agreeing with Jev that changing thirty tests per skill into thirty for the suite weakens coverage requirements and the prescribed work. Retain uncertainty_preserved=true despite Jev: both versions state a proposed minimum directly, and neither claims the example tests ran. Context expressly treats coverage as a proposal requirement rather than proof of an external standard.
